purpose: Bind the recovered Book Intelligence unification architecture into the Book System parent plan so the parent authoring lifecycle consumes existing macro/whole-book intelligence and Prose execution capability instead of redesigning either from scratch.
canonical_unification_rule: Use Creative Excellence granular dimensions plus reader-state and whole-book evidence/assurance architecture as the observation/evaluation taxonomy, and use Literary Prose A-L as the governed execution loop. Neither lineage replaces the other.

book_system_owns: book/chapter/scene lifecycle and canonical version authority
prose_project_owns_within_child_scope: independent literary comparison/evaluation inside Prose scope
narrative extraction/orchestration implementation evidence developed on the child branch
parent_child_separation.book_evaluator_role: Independent Book System capability/qualification lane; provides evaluation evidence but has no parent canonical-write authority.

macro: whole-book Creative Excellence 017/018 synthesis and hard gates
macro_meso_micro_architecture.required_flow: PARENT_CANONICAL_STATE -> MACRO/MESO/MICRO_ANALYSIS -> CALIBRATED_FINDINGS -> BOUNDED_REVISION_OPPORTUNITY -> PROSE_CANDIDATE -> INDEPENDENT_EVALUATION -> AUTHOR/PARENT_DECISION -> EXPLICIT_CANONICAL_COMMIT

reuse_rules: Do not create a replacement whole-book evaluator when Creative Excellence 017/018 already owns the recovered whole-book assurance architecture.
Do not create another generic reader-state system when PCE013 already defines the recovered 64-dimension reader-experience architecture.
Do not create another generic prose rubric when PCE012 and the current Literary Prose specialists already provide the recovered detailed craft architecture.
Create new versioned capability only when forensic crosswalk proves the existing authorities do not own the required behavior or an executable contract is missing.
No child qualification, hosted PASS or A-01 PASS grants automatic Book System admission or canonical mutation.
qualification_effect: NONE. This binding admits architectural lineage and ownership relationships into parent planning only. It does not transfer exact-SHA qualification, production standing, human evidence, author decisions, publication authority or canonical mutation rights.
successor_constraint: The authoring lifecycle contract must consume this binding and must not redesign the Creative Excellence or Literary Prose intelligence stack from first principles.
